headline: China's open GLM-5.3-Flash and Nvidia's record quarter
body: Five small stories, mostly balancing out. China's Z.ai released GLM-5.3-Flash, a 320B open-weight model under an MIT licence; open models spread capability around, easing Power Concentration and helping the Libertarian and Egalitarian utopias. Nvidia's record $96.2 billion quarter added to Capability Velocity. The Guardian exposed an influence operation trying to seed AI chatbots with propaganda, raising Surveillance & Control and lifting 1984. Meta scrapping part of an 'AI-native' plan to cut teams was a small plus for Shared Prosperity. Sam Altman said OpenAI is '80%' to AGI while holding its biggest run until safety controls are ready. Horizon Balance: -4.90.
movers_note: Egalitarian Utopia +0.1 from GLM-5.3-Flash (+0.08) and Meta's reversed cuts (+0.06); Libertarian Utopia +0.1 from GLM-5.3-Flash (+0.13); 1984 +0.1 from the chatbot propaganda story (+0.22).
